answer: SELECT ((SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') - (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')) * 100.0 / (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS pct
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS diff
